buy_and_hold.allocation: Each token receives min(strategy position budget, 90% of starting capital / selected token count). Unallocated, ineligible or failed allocations remain cash; no redistribution.
buy_and_hold.name: Fixed allocation buy-and-hold
buy_and_hold.rule: Decide at the first evaluation bar using available liquidity; buy on the first later bar after the shared delay; hold until segment end. No stops, targets or rebalancing.

momentum.allocation: Same fixed allocation per token as buy-and-hold; no leverage or redistribution.
momentum.name: Simple momentum
momentum.rule: At segment start and every 60 minutes, buy if the available price is at least 1% above the available price 60 minutes earlier. Hold 60 minutes; no stops or targets. No entry while invested or pending.

configuration.hypothesis: When multiple previously profitable wallets accumulate a token, subsequent returns may exceed execution costs.
configuration.name: Smart Money Accumulation

holdout_warning: Historical holdout may already be known from raw data. This lock protects the stored snapshot, not secrecy or absence of human look-ahead.
hypothesis: When multiple previously profitable wallets accumulate a token, subsequent returns may exceed execution costs.
observation_availability: 5m REAL prices available source_price_ts + 300s; exact historical liquidity snapshots; no gap filling. SYNTHETIC observations are simulated.

token_selection.remaining_bias: Wallet itself was selected from a hindsight GMGN PnL ranking. Historical data is not guaranteed unseen.
token_selection.rule: First chronologically observed supported buy, ordered by timestamp, slot and event ID; chosen before fetching this token price series. No returns were used to choose it.

wallet_selection.bias: Wallet selected using a ranking overlapping this historical period. This is retrospective selection bias, not evidence of an unseen or unbiased test.
wallet_selection.purpose: Verify real ingestion and data quality. Missing historical exit liquidity blocks modeled performance.
wallet_selection.redistribution: Not confirmed; raw provider records are kept outside the source repository.
wallet_selection.selection_rule: User supplied the first visible public wallet in a GMGN list sorted by 1D PnL; no wallet returns independently verified.
wallet_selection.window_rule: Fixed 48 hours ending at the last completed UTC hour before selection; do not change after inspecting outcomes.

sensitivity_design.design: Seven pre-specified one-at-a-time rows; base plus low/high fees, delay and unique-wallet threshold. Training only; no best-row selection.
